principle: Guided client walk: the client is walked one step at a time. Each step has one clear action, a visible outcome or value delivered, a gate that must pass before the next step, and shows progress so the client always knows where they are and what is next.

steps.title: Enquiry received
steps.action: Client submits the enquiry form or calls the firm
steps.outcome: Acknowledgement sent with a booked discovery call and a link to their walk progress
steps.gate_check: Contact record exists and discovery call is booked

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.action: Client describes their business, entity type, current software and pain points
steps.outcome: Written summary of needs and the free books health check explained
steps.gate_check: Needs summary saved and client agrees to the health check

steps.title: Grant read-only books access
steps.action: Client grants read-only access or uploads exports (QBO, bank statements, prior returns)
steps.outcome: Firm confirms what it received and what is missing
steps.gate_check: Required exports or read-only access confirmed

steps.title: Free books health check
steps.action: Firm runs the diagnostic on the client's books
steps.outcome: Scored health check report: reconciliation status, months behind, exceptions, filing exposure
steps.gate_check: Report generated and reviewed by a staff accountant

steps.title: Health check walkthrough
steps.action: Client reviews the findings with the firm
steps.outcome: Client understands their books' condition and the recommended next rung
steps.gate_check: Client chooses a path (or declines); next-rung offer approved by a human before it is sent

steps.title: Proposal
steps.action: Client receives a scoped proposal for the chosen rung(s)
steps.outcome: Fixed scope, deliverables and timeline in writing (pricing TBD by Orville)
steps.gate_check: Client accepts the proposal

steps.title: Engagement letter
steps.action: Client signs the engagement letter; responsible professional accepts it
steps.outcome: Signed engagement on file; client is now a client of the firm
steps.gate_check: Signed by client AND accepted by a human professional
steps.human_reason: Engagement letter must be signed by the client and accepted by the responsible professional (CPA Canada / CPA Alberta practice standards).

steps.title: Onboarding and identity verification
steps.action: Client completes identity verification and onboarding profile
steps.outcome: Verified client profile and portal access
steps.gate_check: Identity verification passed

steps.title: Document collection
steps.action: Client uploads outstanding documents from the checklist
steps.outcome: Checklist shows every item received or waived
steps.gate_check: All required documents received

steps.title: Data migration
steps.action: Firm migrates prior-system data (QuickBooks, Caseware, DT Max, WebTax)
steps.outcome: Client's history is in NXT OS with a migration report
steps.gate_check: Migration report passes reconciliation checks

steps.title: Catch-up / cleanup
steps.action: Firm brings books current and fixes historical errors
steps.outcome: Clean, reconciled books up to the current period
steps.gate_check: All catch-up months reconciled with no open exceptions

steps.title: Monthly close
steps.action: Client sends the month's documents; firm closes the month
steps.outcome: Reconciled bank and subledgers for the month
steps.gate_check: Month reconciled; exceptions resolved or carried forward with a note

steps.title: Monthly report
steps.action: Client receives the month-end package
steps.outcome: P&L, balance sheet and exceptions summary in the portal
steps.gate_check: Report delivered; next-rung signals evaluated and any offer approved by a human before it is sent

steps.title: Payroll
steps.action: Client confirms employees and pay schedule
steps.outcome: Payroll running with remittances tracked
steps.gate_check: First pay run reconciled

steps.title: Year-end statements
steps.action: Firm prepares the year-end financial statements
steps.outcome: Draft year-end financial statements
steps.gate_check: Statements prepared and reviewed

steps.title: Client review of statements
steps.action: Client reviews and approves the year-end statements
steps.outcome: Final year-end statements
steps.gate_check: Client approval recorded

steps.title: Tax return preparation
steps.action: Firm prepares the T2 / T1 return
steps.outcome: Draft return with a summary of tax owing or refund
steps.gate_check: Return prepared and reviewed

steps.title: Filing authorization (T183 / T183CORP)
steps.action: Client signs the CRA filing authorization
steps.outcome: Signed authorization on file
steps.gate_check: Signed T183 / T183CORP received and verified by a human
steps.human_reason: CRA requires the client's signed authorization before electronic filing.

steps.title: E-file
steps.action: Preparer submits the return
steps.outcome: Return filed, with the CRA confirmation number saved
steps.gate_check: Filing confirmation recorded by the preparer
steps.human_reason: Filing is submitted under the preparer's EFILE credentials; a human preparer must submit.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.action: Client receives the invoice for the period
steps.outcome: Clear invoice tied to the delivered work
steps.gate_check: Invoice issued

steps.title: Payment
steps.action: Client pays the invoice
steps.outcome: Receipt issued
steps.gate_check: Payment received

steps.title: Annual review
steps.action: Client meets the firm to review the year
steps.outcome: Year in review, KPIs and recommendations; next-rung offer if signals fire
steps.gate_check: Review held; any offer approved by a human before it is sent

steps.title: CFO / advisory
steps.action: Client agrees forecasting and KPI targets
steps.outcome: Forecast and KPI dashboard
steps.gate_check: Dashboard live and first advisory session held

steps.title: Strategic readiness
steps.action: Client sets an exit, acquisition or financing goal
steps.outcome: Readiness plan and data room checklist
steps.gate_check: Plan agreed
